title: security review prep - weekly sync notes (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick personal prep notes + action list for upcoming security & compliance review sync (SOC2 / ISO / vendor risk). This is a scratchpad — incomplete, rough timeline, things to confirm in the meeting.

Context: weekly cross-functional sync with product infra + legal + SRE. Goal = align on evidence collection, outstanding control gaps, and vendor risk remediation plan ahead of auditor kickoff (tentative Q2).

Agenda draft (30-40 min):
- 5m: quick status (audit timeline, stakeholders)
- 10m: SOC2 control mapping updates (what's completed vs open)
- 10m: vendor risk inventory + high-risk vendors (contract + data flow)
- 5m: evidence collection blockers and owners
- 5-10m: action items + next check-in date

Key talking points to hit:
- Remind folks: auditor will want documented control owners + latest evidence by start date. Need someone to confirm ownership for each control next week.
- Emphasize importance of immutable logs for access reviews (Availability/Security).
- We should propose a 2-week cadence for sample evidence drops to auditors instead of one big dump.

Control mapping notes (rough):
- Logical access reviews (SOC2 Security): current state = manual monthly reports from Okta + AWS console logs; gap = no centralized evidence packet with reviewer attestations.
  - Ask: Can Product Ops provide reviewer attestations (email or Confluence sign-off) for last 3 months?
  - Owner idea: Ethan (identity) + Liam (infra) to coordinate.

- Change management (Processing Integrity): PR-based approvals exist but we need a changelog export showing approvals for production deploys over last 6 months.
  - JIRA tickets: INFSEC-1234 tracks automation of changelog export.

- Encryption & key management (Confidentiality): KMS rotation policy documented but missing audit proof of rotation for one customer key (cust-prod-01).
  - Action: Priya to pull KMS rotation history and generate snapshot.

Vendor risk quick notes:
- High risk vendors: "FastLogs Inc." (log ingestion), "EmbedCo" (embeddings provider for experiments)
  - For each: confirm data classification, contract clauses (DPA), subprocessor list, and last pen-test/attestation.
  - Embedded ask to Legal: get copies of current DPAs and confirm any outstanding negotiated exceptions.

Evidence checklist (what auditors will likely request):
- System architecture diagram (public/private subnet, data flow) — update with current VPC peering and private deploys. (Owner: Liam)
- Access control list / RBAC matrix for console, CI, and internal apps. (Owner: Ethan)
- Okta weekly access report exports (last 90 days). (Owner: Ethan)
- KMS key rotation logs + snapshot for customer keys. (Owner: Priya)
- Pen-test report and remediation tracker (PRs/patch commits). (Owner: Jordan)
- Incident response runbook + past incident postmortems (last 12 months). (Owner: Security Ops)
- Vendor DPAs, subprocessors, and SOC2/SOC3 reports from vendors. (Owner: Legal)

Open questions / to confirm in meeting:
- Auditor scope: will they require ISO27001 artifacts in parallel or focus solely on SOC2? (I think we should treat ISO controls as optional but have top-level mapping ready).
- Evidence format preference: PDFs vs Confluence links vs zipped CSVs.
- Sampling approach: how large will sample size be for user access / deployments?
- Any upcoming deployments that could affect controls (e.g., new private deploy rollout next week)?

Risks & mitigation (notes to myself):
- Risk: missing reviewer attestations for logical access reviews -> mitigation: ask managers for retrospective sign-offs and log them as Evidence PR in Confluence.
- Risk: vendor missing attestation -> mitigation: escalate to Legal to request SOC report or tighten data flows until resolved.

Draft action items (assign + due):
- Ethan C: produce Okta export and RBAC matrix draft — due 2025-02-21
- Priya S: KMS rotation snapshot for cust-prod-01 + rotation policy excerpt — due 2025-02-20
- Liam O: update system architecture diagram and annotate private deployment changes — due 2025-02-24
- Jordan R: attach latest pen-test PDF and list of remediation PRs — due 2025-02-21
- Legal (TBD): assemble DPAs for FastLogs Inc. and EmbedCo, confirm subprocessors — ask by 2025-02-19 (follow up if no reply in 3 days)
- Samira (me): collate evidence inventory page in Confluence, create evidence template for owners to upload (consolidated checklist + file naming convention) — due 2025-02-22

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Use evidence naming: SOC2_<control>_<owner>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (helps auditors).
- Keep a running changelog in this doc of what we handed over and when.
- Remind SRE: production deploy audit logs are in CloudTrail S3 bucket (s3://redwood-audit/cloudtrail/) — ensure retention policy covers requested period.

Meeting prep to-dos before next sync:
- Ping Legal (Slack) w/ specific ask + deadline (template message drafted).
- Draft Confluence evidence page skeleton + share link in meeting.
- Compile list of vendors with data flow mini-diagrams (1 slide each) — ask Solutions Eng for help.

Questions to ask auditor (prepare phrasing):
- "For logical access sampling, do you accept manager email attestations captured in Confluence as evidence?"
- "What minimum retention period do you expect for CloudTrail logs for SOC2 scope?"
- "Any preferred format for vendor SOC reports (PDF okay)?"

Quick slack message draft to Legal (to send after sync):
- "Hey @Legal — prepping for SOC2 audit. Can you please pull DPAs and SOC/Security reports for FastLogs Inc and EmbedCo by Wed 2/19? Also confirm whether there are any negotiated exceptions we should be aware of. LMK if you want me to collect contact info. Thanks! — Samira"

Hand-off notes: when owners upload evidence, they must:
- Add ticket link (INFSEC-1234 or AUD-77) in the Confluence page field
- Tag me + relevant control owner in the Confluence page comment
- Use naming convention above

Footer: this is a living scratchpad — will tidy into formal agenda and Confluence page after actions assigned and initial evidence starts appearing.

-- end scratchpad (Samira)
